## About
Buchanan Auto Electric is a rebuild shop and parts supplier on Mandela Parkway in Oakland. Our specialty is the custom rebuilding of alternators, starters, generators and AC and DC electric motors for industrial, vintage and marine applications.
We have decades of experience behind the bench. We use current testing technology to figure out what your unit needs, then do the work by hand the old-fashioned way. Whether you are restoring a classic car, keeping a fleet on the road or need marine electrical components, give us a call or send an email.
Customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 20 reviews.

## Services
- Alternator, starter and generator rebuilding: Custom rebuilds for worn out or shorted units, from everyday vehicles to older machines.
- AC and DC electric motors: Rebuilding of electric motors for industrial, vintage and marine applications.
- Magneto parts and repair: Repair work and parts for magnetos.
- Custom and antique services: Electrical work for classic cars and older equipment that needs a careful hand.
- Fleet maintenance: Ongoing electrical repair and parts support for fleets.
- Hard-to-find replacement parts: Carburetors, starters, alternators, distributors, AC/DC generators and more. If we do not have it, ask and we will try to get it.
- Complete repair or exchange: Have your unit repaired or exchange it for a replacement.
- Diesel injection: Diesel injection work for diesel engines.

## FAQ
Q: Can you get a part that is not on your product list?
A: Yes. Other items are available on request, so contact us and tell us what you need.

Q: Do you work on classic cars and industrial equipment?
A: Yes. We help people restoring classic cars, upgrading industrial machinery and looking for marine electrical components.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us or send an email to talk through your job, request a quote or learn more about our rebuilding process.
